blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have been explored as surrogates for human survey respondents. A more promising application is data augmentation, where LLMs predict new responses from partial human data. However, the semantic similarity between questionnaire items is a known source of correlation between answers. It is thus unclear whether LLMs actually infer meaningful relationships between question-response pairs, or use surface-level comparison between questions as a heuristic. To assess this, we evaluated how three LLMs can predict responses to held-out items in two surveys measuring attitudes toward automated or light-electric vehicles, based on varying proportions of known responses. Performance was compared to two baselines, where new responses were derived by maximizing embedding-similarity to a prior response. While LLMs mostly predicted human responses better than baselines, their performance consistently declined with a lower share of known responses, even aligning with the baseline in one survey. Our results show that LLMs' capacities for augmenting replies varied across surveys, and can revert to the same levels as simpler embedding similarity baselines when less data is available.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)作为人类调查受访者的代词被探索. 一个更有希望的应用是数据增强,其中LLMs预测从部分人类数据得到新的响应. 然而,调查表项目之间的语义相似性是已知的答案之间相互关系的来源. 因此,目前还不清楚的是,LLMs是实际推断出问题-答复对之间有意义的关系,还是将问题之间的表面水平比较作为高压。 为了评估这一点,我们评价了三个有限责任公司如何根据已知答复的不同比例,在两次调查中预测对搁置项目的反应,这些调查是根据对自动化或轻电车辆的态度进行的。 业绩被比作两个基线,即通过尽可能扩大先前反应的同质性得出新的反应。 虽然有限责任公司大多预测人类答复比基线好,但其业绩却持续下降,已知答复所占比例较低,甚至与一项调查的基线一致。 我们的结果表明,各调查中地方政府加强答复的能力各不相同,在数据较少时,可以恢复到简单嵌入类似基线的水平。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Given the costs of conducting surveys, the prospect of using LLM surrogates has gained traction. These can mimic humans to a notable degree, especially when conditioned with contextual information ( Bisbee et al., 2024 ; Dash et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Potential use cases involve generating completely new responses or augmenting existing data with novel but related questions Wallius and Lehtonen (2026) .
blocks.zh: 鉴于进行调查的成本,使用LLM替代物的前景已经增加。 这些可以模仿人类的显著程度,特别是在有背景资料的条件下(Bisbee等人,2024年;Dash等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年)。 潜在的使用案例包括提出全新的答复或用新的但相关的问题补充现有数据(Wallius和Lehtonen)(2026年)。

blocks.en:
However, a foundational matter is yet to be investigated in this context: why do LLMs mimic human responses? Do they perform inferences using internalized knowledge, or base their answers on something more superficial?
In particular, it has been proposed that survey responses are predictable from the semantic similarity between questions ( Arnulf et al., 2014 ; Arnulf et al., 2024 ) .
If so, the performance of LLM surrogates might simply reflect this rather than a genuine understanding of the survey topic.
blocks.zh:
然而,在这方面尚需调查一个基本问题:为什么LLMS会模仿人类的反应? 他们是利用内部化的知识进行推论,还是根据更肤浅的东西来回答?
特别是,有人建议,从问题之间的语义相似性来看,调查答复是可预测的(Arnulf等人,2014年;Arnulf等人,2024年)。
如果是这样,LLM代词的表现可能只是反映了这一点,而不是对调查专题的真正理解。

blocks.en:
To address this, we compared survey responses given by three LLMs and two baselines relying on sentence embedding similarities ( Lehtonen et al., 2025 ) .
We applied each model to two surveys measuring attitudes toward automated vehicles: AV ( Nordhoff et al., 2021 ) and LEV ( Mesimäki and Lehtonen, 2023 ) . Each experiment was run in three variants, predicting novel responses from approximately 20 % 20\% , 50 % 50\% , or 80 % 80\% of known human responses.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一问题,我们比较了三个有限责任公司和两个基于嵌入类似句子的基线的调查答复(Lehtonen等人,2025年)。
我们把每个模型应用于两个测量对自动车辆的态度的调查:AV(Nordhoff等人,2021年)和LEV(Mesimäki和Lehtonen,2023年)。 每个实验都以三个变体运行,预测新颖反应来自大约20%的20\%,50%的50\%,或80%的已知人类反应.

blocks.en: LLMs generally exceeded both baselines in alignment with human responses and sensitivity to the known response rate. However, the performance of all models was systematically lower for LEV, and the baselines even matched LLMs with the known response rate of 20%. We explore possible reasons for this, and their ramifications for using LLMs for survey data augmentation going forward.
blocks.zh: 有限责任清单一般都超过基线,与人类反应一致,并对已知反应率敏感。 然而,所有模型的性能在LEV中系统较低,基线甚至将LLMs与已知的20%的响应率匹配. 我们探索了造成这种情况的可能原因,以及利用有限责任公司进行调查数据扩充的影响。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 LLMs as survey respondents
blocks.zh: 2.1 作为调查对象的法学硕士课程

blocks.en:
As benefits of using LLMs for generating survey responses, Jansen et al. (2023) highlight speed, price, scalability, and the relative consistency across replies ( Gilardi et al., 2023 ) .
Concurrently, prominent concerns include biases ( Kitadai et al., 2024 ) , model opacity ( Eslami et al., 2019 ; Ollion et al., 2024 ) , reproducibility ( Bisbee et al., 2024 ) , struggles with rare domain-specific terms ( Morozovskii and Ramanna, 2023 ) , and partial deviations from human responses.
blocks.zh:
Jansen等人(2023年)利用LLMs生成调查答复的好处是强调速度、价格、可扩展性以及答复之间的相对一致性(Gilardi等人,2023年)。
同时,突出的关切包括偏见(Kitadai等人,2024年),模式不透明。 (Eslami等人,2019年;Ollion等人,2024年),可复制 (Bisbee等人,2024年),与稀有域特定术语(Morozovskii and Ramanna,2023年)斗争,部分偏离人类反应.

blocks.en: Bisbee et al. (2024) compared several ChatGPT 3.5 Turbo “personas” to corresponding sociopolitical groups. Synthetic data exhibited less variation and several statistically significant differences from human responses. Dominguez-Olmedo et al. (2024) evaluated 43 LLMs on questions from the American Community Survey, and found ordering biases for the prompt as well as systematically higher entropy than in human responses. Kitadai et al. (2024) showed discrepancies between humans and GPT-4o-mini in responding to a Japanese financial questionnaire, taking these to illustrate cultural biases inherent in LLMs ( Liang et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: Bisbee等人(2024年)比较了几个ChatGPT 3.5 涡轮对相应社会政治团体的“人物”。 合成数据显示差异较小,在统计学上与人类反应存在若干显著差异。 Dominguez-Olmedo等人(2024年)就美国社区调查的问题评价了43个法学硕士,发现对迅速和有系统地高于人类反应的肽的订单偏差。 Kitadai等人(2024年)在答复日本财务调查表时显示人类与GPT-4o-mini之间的差异,认为这些差异是为了说明LLMs固有的文化偏见(Liang等人,2021年)。

blocks.en:
Nevertheless, additional fine-tuning or prompt engineering can increase human-LLM alignment. Cao et al. (2025) compared the performance of several models in the World Values Survey ( Haerpfer et al., 2022 ) , where fine-tuning by first-token alignment with human replies incurred a major improvement over zero-shot performance. Dash et al. (2025) used Low-Rank Adaptation ( Hu et al., 2021 ) to tune LLMs for responding based on PersonHub profiles ( Ge et al., 2024 ) ,
which allowed smaller and larger models to reach similar levels of consistency. Zhao et al. (2025) found the enhancement of prompts with contextual information to significantly improve the response consistency of four LLMs (GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4 Turbo, LLaMA 3.0-8B, LLaMA 3.1-8B). Zhang et al. (2026) improved human-LLM alignment for three models (GPT 4.1, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude 3.7 Sonnet) with persona prompting.
However, Morocho et al. (2026) found the effects of persona prompting to be limited and partly even negative due to distortions.
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,额外的微调或即时工程可以提高人与LLM的对齐性. 曹 al等编. (2025)比较了"世界价值调查"(Haerpfer等人,2022年)中几个模型的性能,其中通过先对人的答复进行微调,比零镜头性能有了重大改进. Dash等人(2025年)根据PersonHub简介(Ge等人,2024年),使用低Rank适应(Hu等人,2021年)调制LLMs进行响应,
它使较小和更大的模型达到类似的一致性水平。 Zhao等人(2025年)发现用上下文信息增强提示,以显著提高四个LLMs(GPT-3.5 Turbo,GPT-4 Turbo,LLaMA 3.0-8B,LLaMA 3.1-8B)的响应一致性. 张等人(2026年)改进了三种型号(GPT 4.1,双子座2.0 Flash,Claude 3.7 Sonnet)的人类-LLM配对,并带有个人提示.
然而,Morocho等人(2026年)发现,由于扭曲,人的影响有限,甚至有一部分是负面的。

blocks.en: LLMs have been explored for missing value imputation Mangussi et al. (2026) ; Kim and Lee (2026) ; Ji et al. (2024) . Instead of replacing human participants, response-conditioned LLMs could augment dataset by inferring novel answers from existing ones.
blocks.zh: 研究了LLMs的缺失值估算Mangussi等人(2026年);Kim和Lee(2026年);Ji等人(2024年)。 响应性附带条件的LLMs不取代人类参与者,而可以通过从现有答案中推断出新的答案来增强数据集。

blocks.en: 2.2 Semantic predictability of responses
blocks.zh: 2.2 答复的语义可预测性

blocks.en: Arnulf et al. (2014) put forward the semantic theory of survey response (STSR), which states that human answers to surveys can be predicted to a significant degree from the semantic similarity between questions. Using Latent Semantic Analysis (LSA) ( Foltz, 1996 ) and a corpus-based text similarity algorithm ( Mihalcea et al., 2006 ) , Arnulf et al. could explain 60 % − 86 % 60\%-86\% of variance in human answers to the Multifactor Leadership Questionnaire ( Avolio and Bass, 2004 ) . Gefen and Larsen (2017) further partly replicated the Technology Acceptance Model ( Davis, 1989 ) using LSA. Surveying prior work (e.g. Kjell et al. 2019 ; Rosenbusch et al. 2020 ; Larsen et al. 2023 ), Arnulf et al. (2024) contend that semantic similarity could predict human response patterns with 80 % − 90 % 80\%-90\% accuracy.
blocks.zh: 阿努尔夫等人(2014年)提出了调查响应的语义理论(STSR),该理论指出,人类对调查的答案可以从问题之间的语义相似性中在很大程度上预测出来. 使用Latent语义分析(LSA)(Foltz,1996年)和基于实体的文本相似性算法(Mihalcea等人,2006年),Arnulf等人可以解释人类对多因素领导人调查表(Avolio和Bass,2004年)答复的差异60% - 86% 60 - 86%。 Gefen和Larsen(2017年)进一步部分复制了使用LSA的技术接受模型(Davis,1989年). 调查以前的工作(例如Kjell等人) 2019; Rosenbusch 等人 2020; Larsen 等人 , Larsen 等人 , Arnulf 等人 (2024)认为语义相似性可以预测人类的反应模式,准确度为 80% - 90% 80 - 90 QQ 准确度.

blocks.en: Recently, Lehtonen et al. (2025) used Sentence-BERT ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) to generate synthetic answers to a questionnaire concerning automated vehicles ( Nordhoff et al., 2021 ) . Based on selecting the most similar response to a prior one in embedding distance, the synthetic data accounted for 40 % 40\% of between variable correlations (covariance) in human answers.
blocks.zh: 最近,Lehtonen等人(2025年)利用Pried-BERT(Reimers and Gurevich, 2019年)对有关自动化车辆的调查问卷(Nordhoff等人, 2021年)生成合成答案. 基于在嵌入距离中选择与前一个最相似的响应,合成数据占人类答案中可变相关(共变)之间的40%.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据

blocks.en:
We tested LLMs’ ability to perform response-conditioned imputation against human data from two surveys. AV investigates the acceptance of automated driving Nordhoff et al. (2021) . A subset of 22 questions was used, measuring six factors Lehtonen et al. (2025) . 1 1 1 Behavioural Intention, Facilitation Conditions, Hedonic Motivation, Performance Expectancy, Social Influence, Trust. A sample of 500 respondents were drawn at random, derived from the data in Zenodo Nordhoff et al. (2023) . LEV investigates the benefits of light-electric vehicles Mesimäki and Lehtonen (2023) .
The original 646 respondents were pruned to 426 by removing those where the response was missing or ‘‘don’t know’’.
A subset of 21 questions was used, forming four factors 2 2 2 Accessibility, Safe, Comfort, Practicality. along with eight additional questions.
Unlike AV, LEV is not publicly available online.
blocks.zh:
我们测试了LLMS根据两次调查得出的人类数据进行有响应条件的估算的能力。 AV调查验收自动驾驶诺德霍夫等人(2021年). 使用了22个问题,衡量了6个因素:Lehtonen等人(2025年)。 根据Zenodo Nordhoff等人(2023年)的数据,随机抽取了500名答卷人。 LEV调查轻电车Mesimäki和Lehtonen(2023)的好处.
最初的646名被调查者因删除了没有答复或不知道答复的答案而被挤到426人。
使用了由21个问题组成的子集,构成4个因素 2 2 无障碍、安全、舒适、实用。 以及另外八个问题。
与AV不同,LEV不在网上公开.

blocks.en: Three masked datasets were created for both surveys by varying the share of known responses (20%, 50%, 80%, rounded to the nearest integer). Question order was randomized for each participant, and answers were masked from the end. The six masked datasets were used for generating responses, providing identical inputs between models.
blocks.zh: 通过对已知答复的比例(20%、50%、80%,四舍五入到最接近的整数)的不同,为这两项调查创建了三个遮掩数据集。 每个参与者的提问顺序都随机排列,回答从结尾遮掩. 六个蒙面数据集用于生成响应,提供模型之间的相同输入.

blocks.en: 3.2 Response generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 生成反应

blocks.en: Three LLMs (Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT 5.6 Luna, Mistral 4 Small) were used with a system prompt to generate consistent answers based on known question-answer pairs (see Appendix A ). The task prompt instructed the model to provide answers to questions when these were masked, based on known question-answer pairs (see Appendix B ). 3 3 3 Mistral generated nine answers with duplicated question IDs, which were removed. No other output errors appeared.
blocks.zh: 使用了三种LLMS(Gemini 3.7 Flash,GPT 5.6 Luna,Mistral 4 Small),系统即时根据已知的问答对生成一致的答案(见附录A). 任务提示指示模型在问题被掩盖时,根据已知的对答(见附录B)提供答案。 3 3 3 Mistral 生成9个回答,重复的问题ID,被删除. 没有出现其他输出错误 。

blocks.en:
The semantically derived baselines exemplify the Semagent method, where the response is chosen by maximizing its embedding similarity to a prior response Lehtonen et al. (2025) .
Responses are sentences that combine the question and answer: I <statement> that <answer> .
The algorithm was initialized with ‘‘memorized’’ responses from known question-answer pairs. 4 4 4 This contrasts the original method of Lehtonen et al. (2025) , where memorized responses were selected at random. We also did not add noise to the responses. An embedding similarity matrix across possible responses was created for both SBERT ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) and Gemini embeddings.
The response was greedily selected based on the most similar prior response, as other means did not consistently improve performance (see Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
模拟推导的基线就是Semagent方法的例证,在该方法中,通过最大限度地将其嵌入到与先前反应Lehtonen等人(2025年)相似的状态来选择反应。
答复是将问答结合起来的句子:我 " 陈述 " 就是 " 回答 " 。
该算法由已知的回答对的QQ默化回答初始化. 页:1 4,这与莱托宁等人(2025年)的原始方法形成对比,该方法随机选择了被记住的回复. 我们还没有在答复中增加噪音。 为SPERT(Reimers and Gurevich, 2019)和双子座嵌入设定了跨可能的反应的类似性矩阵.
由于其他手段没有始终如一地改善业绩,因此在最相似的先前答复基础上对答复进行了贪婪的选择(见附录D)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 分析

blocks.en:
Alignment between human and model-generated data was estimated with Cohen’s kappa ( κ \kappa ) Bendavid (2008) , calculated only from predicted answers.
Squared weighting was used since responses were ordinal. 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were bootstrapped with 500 iterations and bias-corrected and accelerated (BCa) bootstrap intervals. Respondent-level clustering was used since multiple responses were from each participant violate the assumption of independent observations.
Statistical inferences were performed by bootstrapping the difference in κ \kappa statistics ( Δ ​ κ \Delta\kappa ). Bonferroni correction was applied with multiple comparisons (See Appendix C for further details).
blocks.zh:
估计人类数据和模型生成数据与科恩的kappa(o&kappa )相吻合。 Bendavid (2008),只根据预测的答案计算.
采用了平方加权法,因为答复是平方。 95%的置信间隔(CIs)用500次迭代和偏差纠正和加速(BCa)的靴子间隔。 使用了答复方一级的分组,因为每个参与者都作出了多项答复,这违反了独立观察的假设。
统计推论是通过绑定 $\ kappa 统计值的差值(\\ Delta\ kappa ) 来进行的。 Bonferroni的校正经过多次比较(详见附录C)。

blocks.en: Covariance recovery was assessed with covariance matrices. Frobenius norms for the difference between human and imputed datasets measure their Euclidean distance. RV coefficients between these matrices measure the similarity of their shapes. Factor structure recovery was investigated with confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). Previously validated factor structures were used for both human and imputed datasets.
blocks.zh: 对共变物回收情况进行了评估。 弗罗贝尼乌斯规范用于衡量人类和被估算的数据集的区别,测量它们的欧几利得距离. 这些矩阵之间的RV系数测量其形状的相似性. 对因数结构的恢复进行了确认因数分析。 人类数据集和估算数据集都使用了以前经过验证的系数结构。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Alignment with human data
blocks.zh: 4.1 与人类数据保持一致

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows κ \kappa for each model with different shares of known answers. Δ ​ κ \Delta\kappa values with 95% CIs for the pairwise contrasts are reported in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 图1显示每个模型的 & kappa,已知答案份额不同。 \\Delta\kappa 值,对齐对比值为 95% CI ,见附录 C 。

blocks.en:
LLMs show a systematic pattern with 50% known response rate: Gemini 3.7 Flash outperforms GPT 5.6 Luna, and GPT 5.6 Luna outperforms Mistral 4 Small. With 20% and 80% known response rates, the pattern was repeated but not all pairwise differences were statistically significant.
With Semagent baselines, Gemini produced more aligned responses than SBERT for AV with 50 % and 80 % of known answers. Otherwise the difference was not statistically significant.
LLMs always outperformed the best Semagent (Gemini) in AV. For LEV, the LLM advantage was more limited: Gemini 3.7 Flash outperformed baselines with 50% and 80% known response rates, and GPT 5.6 Luna with 50%.
blocks.zh:
LLMS表现出系统模式,已知反应率达到50%:双子座3.7闪电超过GPT 5.6 Luna,GPT 5.6 Luna超过Mistral 4 Small. 已知的回复率为20%和80%,这种模式一再出现,但并非所有对等差异都具有统计意义。
有了Semagent基线,双子座对AV的响应比SPERT更一致,拥有50%和80%已知的答案. 否则,这一差异在统计学上就无足轻重。
LLMS总表现优于AV中最好的司马根(英语:Gemigent (Gemini)). 对于LEV来说,LLM的优势比较有限:双子座3.7 Flash以50%和80%的已知响应率超过了基线,而GPT 5.6 Luna则以50%的速度超过了基线.

blocks.en: All LLMs were more aligned in AV compared to LEV with 20% and 50% of known responses, but only Mistral 4 Small with 80%. Semagents’ performance was not different between datasets.
blocks.zh: 所有LLMS在AV中比LEV更一致,已知的回复率分别为20%和50%,但只有Mistral 4 Small以80%. Semagents的性能在数据集之间并无不同。

blocks.en: Figure 1: κ \kappa between human and generated responses by different shares of known responses. Means and 95 % 95\% CIs.
blocks.zh: 图1:已知反应中不同份额的人类和生成反应之间的百分率。 手段和95%的95%的CIs。

blocks.en: 4.2 Known response rates
blocks.zh: 4.2 已知答复率

blocks.en: LLMs produced more aligned responses with a known response rate of 50% rather than 20%, across both datasets. The increase from 50% to 80% also improved alignment, but this was statistically significant only for Gemini 3.7 Flash in LEV. An improvement from 20% to 50% was found in Semagent baselines as well, but only in AV.
blocks.zh: 有限责任公司在两个数据集中都作出了更加一致的答复,已知的答复率为50%,而不是20%。 由50%增加到80%也改善了配比,但这在统计学上仅对LEV中的双子座3.7 Flash很重要. 司马根基线也从20%提高到50%,但只在反车辆地雷方面。

blocks.en: 4.3 Covariance and factor structure
blocks.zh: 4.3 一致性和系数结构

blocks.en: Increasing known responses improved covariance preservation both in terms of the shape and magnitude (Table 1 ) of the covariance matrix. With a 20% rate, LLMs had an advantage over Semagents in L3Pilot. Otherwise, LLMs did not show a strong improvement over Semagents.
blocks.zh: 已知的响应增加,从共变矩阵的形状和规模(表1)来看,都改善了共变保全。 以20%的比率,LLMs比L3Pilot的Semagents拥有优势. 否则,LLMs没有表现出比Semagents的强劲改善.

blocks.en: Table 1: RV coefficient(range: 0 − 1 0-1 , higher is better) and Frobenius norms (lower is better) for imputed datasets.
blocks.zh: 表1:估算数据集的RV系数(范围:0 - 1 0-1,较高更好)和Frobenius规范(较低更好).

blocks.en: LLM-imputed datasets contained the same factor structure as human data with 50%–80% of known answers (see Appendix E ). With 20%, only Mistral 4 Small converged. Semagents never converged. Generated data shows systematic item-level biases.
blocks.zh: LLM-imputingdatas集包含与人类数据相同的系数结构,已知答案的50~~80%(见附录E. 与20%,只有Mistral 4 Small汇合. 司马进士从未合. 生成的数据表明了系统的项目层面偏差。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Excluding LEV with 20 % 20\% known response rate, all LLMs outperformed both Semagents across all experiment variants. Of the Semagents, Gemini Embeddings systematically performed better than SBERT. As expected, a higher share of known responses increased alignment with human responses as well as covariance preservation. However, both Semagents were impacted less by known response rate than LLMs. For LLMs, the increase from 20 % 20\% to 50 % 50\% had a larger impact than the increase from 50 % 50\% to 80 % 80\% . With 50 % − 80 % 50\%-80\% known response rates, LLM and human data aligned in factor structure.
blocks.zh: 不包括20%20%的已知响应率的LEV,所有LLMS在所有实验变体中都超过了两个Semagents. 在司马根人中,双子座嵌入系统表现优于SBERT. 正如预期的那样,已知的对策中较高比例的对策加强了与人类对策的配合以及共同性保护。 然而,Semagent人受到已知答复率的影响比LLMs小。 对地方政府来说,从20% 20%增加到50% 50%的影响大于从50% 20%增加到80% 80%。 50% - 80% 50% - 80 % 已知的响应率,LLM和人类数据在系数结构中一致.

blocks.en: The two surveys diverge in how LLMs relate to Semagents. All LLMs had a higher alignment with human data in AV, and also LLMs’ advantage was greater. LLMs in AV markedly increased from 20 % 20\% to 50 % 50\% , but remained relatively stagnant after this. In LEV, LLM’s performance was closer to Semagents, but increased more steadily with known response rates. Finally, LEV with 20 % 20\% known response rate constitutes a crucial outlier among our results: all models had poor performance, and the otherwise clear distinction between LLMs and Semagents is absent.
blocks.zh: 两项调查在有限责任公司与Semagents公司的关系上存在分歧。 所有LLMS都与AV中的人类数据更加一致,LLMs的优势也更大. AV的LLMs明显从20% 20%增至50% 50%,但此后相对停滞不前。 在LEV中,LLM的性能更接近于Semagents,但随着已知的响应率而更加稳定地增长. 最后,有20%的已知响应率的LEV在我们的成果中构成了一个关键的外部因素:所有模型的性能都很差,而LLMs和Semagents之间没有明显的区别。

blocks.en:
The results may be influenced by AV being open access while LEV is not. Open datasets can be present in the training data of LLMs, artificially facilitating their performance Mangussi et al. (2026) . AV might also be similar to other datasets that LLMs have been exposed to during training, since its topic – automated vehicle acceptance – is widely studied. LEV, in turn, concerns a more specialized theme on with fewer studies. Hence, with LEV, overlap with training data is impossible and model generalization based on similar training data is less likely.
With 20% of known answers, LLM performance in LEV closely matched that of Semagents. In line with the STSR, this may indicate that LLMs were unable to use memorized question-answer pairs and reverted to using generic semantic information as Semagents.
blocks.zh:
结果可能受AV是开放访问而LEV不是影响. 开放数据集可以存在于LLMs的训练数据中,人为地促进其性能Mangussi等人(2026年). AV也可能与LLMs在培训期间接触过的其他数据集类似,因为其主题——自动车辆接收——被广泛研究. LEV则涉及一个较为专业的主题,研究较少。 因此,与低能评价系统相比,与培训数据重叠是不可能的,基于类似培训数据的模型一般化的可能性较小。
有了20%的已知答案,LEV中的LLM性能与司马根特斯非常吻合. 根据STSR,这可能表明LLMs无法使用被记住的问答对并恢复使用通用语义信息作为Semagents.

blocks.en: Together, the impact of known answer rate and the contrast between datasets suggest that LLMs’ access to both contextual and memorized information is key for explaining their performance.
blocks.zh: 已知的回答率的影响和数据集之间的对比表明,LLMs获得背景信息和记忆信息是解释其性能的关键。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
We draw two key takeaways from our results.
First, the response augmentation capacities of LLMs can vary significantly across surveys and known response rates. Second, comparison to embedding similarity baselines indicates that LLMs do not always exceed the performance of simpler semantic similarity metrics. This is in line with the STSR, which states that survey responses are substantially predictable from the semantics of questions. Assessing it has been rare in prior work on LLM surrogates, and we stress the need to include it as part of the experimental setup going forward.
blocks.zh:
我们从结果中抽取了两个关键的外卖。
首先,各调查及已知答复率之间,法学硕士课程的响应增强能力差异很大。 其次,与嵌入相似性基线的比较表明,LLMS并不总是超过简单的语义相似性度量度的性能. 这与STSR是一致的,STSR指出,从提问的语义上来说,调查的答复是基本上可预测的. 在以往关于LLM替代物的工作中很少评估这个问题,我们强调,必须将其作为今后实验设置的一部分。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This short paper has experimented on three English-dominant LLMs (Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT 5.6 Luna, and Mistral 4 Small) and two Semagent baselines (built on SBERT all-mpnet-v2 and Gemini embeddings). The survey questions were formulated in English and concerns a highly specific domains. For broader conclusions to be drawn, a range of similar evaluations are needed at a broader scale, encompassing a variety of survey domains, model architectures, fine-tuning and prompting regimes, as well as different languages and sociodemographic groups.
blocks.zh: 这篇短篇论文在三个英属主力LLMs(Gemini 3.7 Flash,GPT 5.6 Luna,和Mistral 4 Small)和两个司马根基线(建于SPERT All-mpnet-v2和双子座嵌入)上进行了实验. 调查问题用英语提出,涉及一个非常具体的领域。 为了得出更广泛的结论,需要在更广泛的范围内进行一系列类似的评价,包括各种调查领域、示范结构、微调和激励制度以及不同语言和社会人口群体。

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: All research procedures and protocols are exempt from review board approval according to the applicable guidelines. Publicly available survey data contained no personal data. Respondents were adults, who gave informed consent for participation and use of their responses for research. The results indicate that using LLMs or semantic baselines for data augmentation may introduce systematic item-level biases, which should be considered.
blocks.zh: 根据适用的准则,所有研究程序和协议都不受审查委员会的批准。 公开调查数据中没有个人数据。 答复者是成年人,成年人在知情的情况下同意参与并使用其答复进行研究。 结果表明,使用LLMS或语义基线进行数据扩充可能会带来系统性的项目层面偏差,对此应予以考虑。

blocks.en: Appendix D Testing Semagent with different neighbourhood sizes
blocks.zh: 附录D 测试 具有不同面积的街道

blocks.en: Semagent algorithm can be criticized for using only the most similar given response to select the new response option. (We thank an anonymous reviewer for pointing this out.) It can be asked if its performance would be better if the new response option is selected by maximizing the similarity to a larger set of given responses.
blocks.zh: Semagent算法可以被批评只使用最相似的给定响应来选择新的响应选项. (我们感谢一位匿名评论员指出这一点。 ) 可以问到,如果选择新的响应选项时能最大限度地实现与更大系列特定响应的相似性,其性能是否更好.

blocks.en: Therefore, we developed Semagent-k, a variant of the original algorithm which uses k k -nearest neighborhood (kNN) approach for identifying the top k k questions in terms of highest cosine similarity of the given response and considered response options. Then the response option with the highest number of occurrences within the top k k question is chosen. If the two response options have the same count, the option with highest cosine similarity is taken. When there were not enough given responses available, then all the available pairs were used. The original greedy Semagent version is equivalent to Semagent-k with k k = 1.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们开发了Semagent-k,这是原始算法的一个变体,它使用kk - 近邻(kNN)方法,从给定答复的最高余弦相似性的角度确定顶端的kk问题,并考虑了答复选项。 然后选择最高 k k 问题中发生次数最多的响应选项 。 如果两个响应选项的计数相同,则采用最大余弦相似性的选项. 如果没有足够的答复,则使用所有可用的对子。 最初贪婪的司马根特版本相当于以kk=1.

blocks.en: We tested k = 1 , 3 , 11 k=1,3,11 and 22 22 with 50% of known answers with the same respondents as in the main analysis (Appendix Table 3 ). With Gemini Embeddings, the k = 3 , 11 k=3,11 , or 22 22 did not results in a statistically significantly better κ \kappa than k k = 1 (Appendix Figure 3 . With SBERT, in contrast, k k = 1 did perform statistically significantly worse than the others.

blocks.en: Appendix E Factor structure and item-level biases
blocks.zh: 附录E 因素结构和项目层面的偏差

blocks.en: Factor structure preservation was investigated by fitting the previously confirmed factor structure to the imputed datasets using confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). CFA fit indices are given in Appendix Table 5 . All LLM imputed dataset have fit indices similar to the human datasets, expect for the cases where the model did not converge. Semagent imputed datasets did not converge.
blocks.zh: 采用确认系数分析法(CFA)将先前确认的系数结构与估算的数据集相匹配,从而对系数结构保存进行了调查。 附录表5列出了非洲金融共同体指数。 所有LLM估算数据集都有与人类数据集相似的指数,预计模型未趋同的个案. Semagent 估算数据集没有汇合。

blocks.en: Analysis of item-level biases give additional insights to the covariance and factor structure preservations. We computed Vargha and Delaney’s A A effect size, a measure of probability of superiority, by comparing LLM-generated responses with human baseline responses. Values range from 0 to 1, where A = 0.5 A=0.5 indicates identical distributions, A < 0.5 A<0.5 indicates systematically lower LLM-generated scores relative to the human baseline, and A > 0.5 A>0.5 indicates systematically higher scores. The result show that each LLM have their own systematic tendency to rate some items higher or lower regardless the share of known responses. For Semagent data, the magnitude of the bias is particularly strong for some items.
blocks.zh: 分析物品层面的偏差,可以进一步了解一致性和要素结构的保全。 我们通过将LLM生成的响应与人类基线响应进行比较,计算出Vargha和Delaney的AA效应大小,这是衡量优势概率的尺度。 值从0到1,其中A=0.5 A=0.5表示相同的分布,A < 0.5 A<0.5表示与人类基线相比,LLM产生的分数系统较低,A > 0.5 A>0.5表示系统较高的分数. 结果显示,无论已知答复的比例如何,每个LLM都有自己对一些项目进行高低评分的系统倾向. 就Semagent数据而言,某些项目偏差的程度特别大。
